description: Grants the real CI-Server web app (served remotely at http://127.0.0.1:8642 / http://localhost:8642 after the bootstrap page's window.location.replace()) enough Tauri IPC reachability to complete native 'Sign in with CI Portal': open_external_url_command (launch the OIDC URL in the system browser) and take_pending_deep_link_command (drain a companion://oidc/callback deep link that arrived before the page's listener was up). Both are app-level commands (see main.rs), not plugin commands, so Tauri's ACL has no per-command allow-list for them — the only lever this file has is IPC reachability itself. `permissions` is deliberately left empty so this origin gets NONE of `default.json`'s core:window:*/opener:default grants (window close/hide/show/unminimize/focus, generic URL/path opening) — see that file's own description for why those must stay bootstrap-only. The unavoidable trade-off of using IPC reachability as the only scoping lever is that this origin can also reach this app's other custom commands (stack start/stop, docker checks, log reading, etc.) since Tauri does not gate app-level commands per-command without a custom Rust permission definition (`src-tauri/permissions/*.toml` + build.rs wiring) — out of scope for this fix; a follow-up should add that for true per-command scoping.
